name: unique-heaven-purchasing-coin
unmodelled: Bought Fate flips a crit taken: the engine cannot change a roll already made, so the first crit taken each fight heals back 40 % of that hit (the crit's excess at a 1.7 multiplier), once a fight
Bought Fate failed evade and failed escape: the build has no evade stat and the engine has no escape, so only the crit branch is run
Bought Fate spirit-stone price (5 % of carried stones per flip): the engine has no carried currency; the cost is not charged
Iron Skin Renewed (Tortoise-Scale Armour) and Final Clause (Hundred-Patch Armour): not written, the build does not rely on them
